# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.3.1

Version 1.3.1 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.3.0

- **Autosave every minute.** Outdoors, the game now saves every minute by default (it was every 5 minutes), so
  closing it or a crash loses about a minute at most. Saving when you go in or out of a building and when you quit
  is unchanged.
- The interval is `autosave_every` in `settings.ini` (minutes, 1-60). v1.3.0 wrote `autosave_minutes = 5` there
  whenever a setting was saved; that value is now ignored, so updating from v1.3.0 gives the new default. Another
  value you wrote there by hand is still used.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

What v1.3.0 brought (autosave, Mr. Resetti off by default, custom designs, villagers in their houses and more of the
town in multiplayer) is in the [v1.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.3.0).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- Multiplayer has not changed: v1.3.0 and v1.3.1 can play in the same room (v1.2.0 and earlier cannot).

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Saving: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#saving). Multiplayer:
  [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.1-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.1-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.1-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.3.1-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Linux, with the `settings.ini` of v1.3.0 (`autosave_minutes = 5`): over 200 s of play the game saved at 75, 135
  and 195 s, every 60 s. With `autosave_every = 2` it saved after two minutes.
- All unit tests pass. No change to the decomp.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.3.1, versionCode 10301).

## Known limitations

The same as v1.3.0 (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.3.0)): other
players do not hold the tool or item in their hand; villagers in their houses follow the host's only while the host is
in the same house; the timed autosave waits until you are outdoors in the town.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
